inputs.model.prompt:
Create ONE landscape character turnaround image of the exact same adult man
shown in the supplied reference portrait, repeated in exactly FOUR full-body
views arranged in a single horizontal row. From LEFT TO RIGHT, the views are:
FRONT facing the viewer; LEFT THREE-QUARTER with his anatomical left side
visible and his nose pointing toward image-left; LEFT PROFILE showing his
anatomical left side, nose pointing toward image-left; BACK facing away.
These view names are instructions only: do not print any words in the image.

All four figures must be the SAME individual, not variations or different men.
Match the portrait's angular adult face, jaw and nose structure, tired eyes and
under-eye shadows, dark-brown short tousled hair with irregular locks, and
short beard/stubble. Preserve the apparent adult age and natural proportions
of the reference without assigning an exact age, ethnicity, numerical height,
or new exact iris colour. Keep fatigue visible without caricature. Do not
beautify, rejuvenate, smooth away the under-eye shadows, groom the hair into a
different hairstyle, add muscular bulk, or turn him into a fashion model.

In every view retain the same anthracite suit jacket and matching trousers,
light-grey shirt with open collar, no tie, and the visible waist/belt treatment
of the portrait. Preserve the visible jacket cut, shirt opening, restrained
fabric folds and clothing colours; do not replace the shirt with ivory or
white, or turn the suit green. For the unseen lower legs and feet, use a
restrained exploratory completion: trousers continuing the same anthracite
fabric and simple matte-black dress shoes, identical in all four views, with
no conspicuous branding or decorative additions. The shoes and unseen
tailoring are NEW visual proposals, not details established by the portrait.

Neutral standing comparison pose in each view: feet comfortably planted,
arms relaxed beside the body with hands visible and empty, shoulders relaxed,
head aligned with the view, subdued neutral expression. Do not copy the
leaning doorway pose, pocketed hand, or downward head tilt from the portrait.
Keep all four figures at the same drawn scale with head tops and soles aligned,
equal spacing, clear separation, and enough margin above the hair and below
both shoes. Show complete bodies from hair to soles without cropping or
overlap. Use a consistent eye-level, low-distortion comparison presentation.

Match the reference's realistic-proportion semi-anime drawn rendering: fine
visible dark contours, restrained painterly cel facets and natural anatomical
volumes, not a photograph, plastic 3D render or chibi. Retain the muted
Matrix-influenced olive/charcoal graphic sensibility subtly in the painted
shadow treatment, without recolouring the clothing or washing the skin green.
Place the figures on a uniform plain NEUTRAL GREY background with soft,
diffuse, even illumination identical across all four views. Make the face,
beard, jacket, shirt, hands and trousers clearly readable for comparison,
including dark fabric detail. Do not copy the portrait's dramatic nocturnal
lighting, amber rim light, deep black shadows, doorway, apartment, furniture,
windows or city background. No scene, narrative action, cats, extra people,
props, new accessories, text, labels, borders, panel dividers or watermark.
